what: On entering the region section, that section’s faded map (opacity .3) stays pinned in place and follows behind the list. When the top edge of the real map at the end of the section reaches that spot, the faded map disappears and the real map’s pins drop in with individual delays (20, 50, 15, 120, 25, 90, 35, 400, 450ms) from 3.47vw above over .3s on the bouncy curve cubic-bezier(0,.05,.675,1.625) (opacity .2s linear). Scrolling back, the pins retract with the same delays on .645,.045,.355,1 and the faded map sticks again. Hovering a pin scales it to 1.2x

options.ghost: Opacity of the faint map that follows while attached, default .3
options.lift: Height where the pin starts dropping (with unit), default 3.47222vw — phone original 6.66667vw
options.dur: Length of the pin drop and retract (sec), default .3 — phone original .5
options.ease: Drop curve ‹a,b,c,d›, default 0,0.05,0.675,1.625 (bounces and lands) — the phone original has no curve, just ease
options.delays: Delay per pin (ms, a space-separated list that repeats), default 20 50 15 120 25 90 35 400 450
options.[data-fx-part=ghost]: (optional) blurred map placed absolutely inside the section — if absent, it turns on when the top edge of the real map reaches the section’s top edge (the top of the screen)
options.[data-fx-part=map] · [data-fx-part=pin]: The real map and the pins inside it (the only required child is one map)
options.[data-fx-part=base]: (Optional) Base layer of a real map — with --fx-base-off: 0 it turns on together with the pins (phone original)

use:
Blurred map svg
…List…
Pin
note: For the blurred map, when the section width equals the screen width, setting left·width in % keeps it in the same place even when attached. If parallax (center-parallax etc.) is applied to the blurred map too, include that shift so it matches the real map (Rellax .2 on the original #map).

from.where: index.html [data-slot=movie] .mk-map(ghost)·.mk-map2(map) — original top.js onScroll (once past the top edge of #movie, #map.fixed opacity .3, at #map2 .map-target #map.hide · #map2 hide removed) · top.css .map2.hide .marks .item translate3d(0,-3.47222vw,0)
